explanation_full: The Decision Tree model exhibits a moderate fit to the data, as reflected by its R2 score of 0.56. This implies that approximately 56% of the variance in the target variable can be explained by the model.  While the RMSE (Root Mean Squared Error) of 0.1755 and MAE (Mean Absolute Error) of 0.1086 suggest a degree of error in predictions, the scatter plot indicates a generally linear relationship between actual and predicted values, with data points clustering around the diagonal line representing perfect agreement. However, some deviations from this line are noticeable, indicating that the model may not fully capture all complexities within the data.  Further analysis of these deviations could provide valuable insights for enhancing the model's predictive accuracy.
